POP3::enable
Description
This command will enable STARTTLS for POP3.
Syntax
POP3
::
enable
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
if
{
([
IP
::
addr
[
IP
::
client_addr
]
equals
10.0
.0.0
/
8
])
}
{
POP3
::
enable
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANY
